title: Scalable Benchmarking Framework for Dynamic Quantum Circuits
summary: Dynamic quantum circuits with mid-circuit measurements (MCMs) and feed-forward operations play a crucial role in various applications, such as quantum error correction and quantum algorithms. With advancements in quantum hardware enabling the implementation of MCM and feed-forward loops, the use of dynamic circuits has become increasingly prevalent.
